topic: Ethan Kross (2014) University of Michigan Five-Minute Speech Stress & Silent Named Self-Talk Experiments, Moser (2017) One-Second Effortless Brain Calming, and Midnight Replay Shutdown
act5_climax_episode: Keeping first-name coaching completely silent inside your head to boost stage composure and shut down late-night shame replays across seven studies at zero cost.
